title: The Missing Sock Portal
subtitle: A choose-your-own-adventure chore quest
author: Family Chores Game
summary: A mysterious glowing sock appears in the laundry basket, pulling the hero into a strange world of missing clothes, mischievous lint creatures, and heroic household choices.

credits.notes: Replace placeholder images and audio with generated assets before production.

nodes.title: The Basket Begins to Glow
nodes.text: You are folding laundry when one lonely striped sock begins to glow bright blue. The basket shakes. A tiny voice squeaks, “Help! The Sock Kingdom is in terrible trouble!” A swirling portal opens between the towels.

choices.label: Shine the flashlight into the portal
choices.description: Use light to see what is waiting on the other side.
choices.unavailableText: You need a flashlight to safely peek into the portal.

choices.label: Tie a rope to the laundry basket
choices.description: Make sure you can find your way back home.
choices.unavailableText: You need rope before climbing into a mysterious laundry portal.

choices.label: Offer the glowing sock a snack
choices.description: Maybe magical socks get hungry too.
choices.unavailableText: You need a snack pack to try this very scientific plan.

nodes.title: The Lint Cavern
nodes.text: Your flashlight beam reveals a cavern made of dryer lint. Tiny lint creatures freeze in place. One wears a crown made from a lost button. “No chores beyond this point!” it squeaks.

choices.label: Return the shiny button
choices.description: Show the lint king you came in peace.
choices.unavailableText: A spare button would make an excellent peace offering.

choices.label: Sweep a path through the lint
choices.description: Clear the way with a trusty broom.
choices.unavailableText: You need a broom to clear the lint safely.

nodes.title: The Wobbly Towel Bridge
nodes.text: The rope keeps you steady as you step onto a bridge woven from bath towels. Below, mismatched socks tumble like leaves in a storm. Across the bridge stands a giant washing machine door.

choices.label: Clip the bridge with clothespins
choices.description: Stabilize the towel bridge before crossing.
choices.unavailableText: You need clothespins to secure the bridge.

choices.label: Use a magnet to pull the zipper path closer
choices.description: A clever shortcut appears in the fabric.
choices.unavailableText: You need a magnet to pull the zipper path closer.

nodes.title: A Very Hungry Sock
nodes.text: The glowing sock happily accepts the snack. “Finally! Someone with manners.” It wiggles into the shape of an arrow and points toward a secret tunnel behind the dryer sheets.

choices.label: Follow the sock map
choices.unavailableText: You need a paper map to copy the sock’s directions.

choices.label: Put on gloves and open the dryer sheet tunnel
choices.unavailableText: You need gloves before touching the static tunnel.

nodes.title: The Lint King’s Bargain
nodes.text: The Lint King places the shiny button on his crown and bows. “Brave folder of laundry, I shall help you. The missing socks are trapped behind the Dryer Gate.”

choices.label: Use the tiny key from the Lint King
choices.unavailableText: The Lint King must give you this key first.

choices.label: Sweep the Dryer Gate clean
choices.description: A clean gate may open on its own.
choices.unavailableText: You need a broom to clear the Dryer Gate.

nodes.title: The Dryer Gate
nodes.text: The Dryer Gate spins slowly. Inside, hundreds of missing socks chant, “Pair us! Pair us!” The gate needs one final act of courage, cleverness, or tidiness.

choices.label: Sort the socks into the laundry basket
choices.description: Restore order with heroic sorting skills.
choices.unavailableText: You need a laundry basket to sort the socks.

choices.label: Tie the socks together with magic thread
choices.description: Create a chain of socks back to the real world.
choices.unavailableText: You need magic thread for this ending.

choices.label: Blow the whistle and call everyone home
choices.description: A loud solution to a silly problem.
choices.unavailableText: You need a whistle to call the socks.

nodes.title: The Zipper Shortcut
nodes.text: You unzip a hidden path in the fabric of the Sock Kingdom. It leads straight to the royal sorting room, where the missing socks wait in a giant tangled pile.

choices.label: Use sorting cards to match every pair
choices.description: Organize the socks by color, size, and pattern.
choices.unavailableText: You need sorting cards to organize the sock pile.

choices.label: Collect every sock in the laundry basket
choices.unavailableText: You need a laundry basket to carry the socks home.

nodes.title: Ending: Friend of the Lint Kingdom
nodes.text: With the tiny key, you open the Dryer Gate without a single battle. The socks cheer, the Lint King declares you an official friend of the kingdom, and your laundry pile at home is suddenly perfectly folded.

ending.replayHint: What if you skipped the Lint King and found the Dryer Gate another way?
ending.rewardSummary: You earned coins and unlocked the Tiny Diplomat badge.

nodes.title: Ending: Laundry Legend
nodes.text: You sort, sweep, fold, and rescue every missing sock. The portal closes with a sparkle. Back home, the laundry basket glows once more and drops a golden coin into your hand.

ending.replayHint: Can you find an ending where the socks return home in a completely different way?
ending.rewardSummary: You earned bonus coins and the Laundry Legend achievement.

nodes.title: Ending: Savior of Socks
nodes.text: Using clever tools and careful planning, you guide every sock safely home. From this day forward, socks everywhere whisper your name with respect.

ending.replayHint: Try using louder, sillier tools next time and see what happens.
ending.rewardSummary: You earned coins and a rare sock-themed collectible.

nodes.title: Ending: The Great Sock Stampede
nodes.text: You blow the whistle. Every sock in the kingdom launches through the portal at once. It works! Mostly. Your room is now full of socks, but at least none are missing.

ending.replayHint: There may be a tidier way to save the socks.
ending.rewardSummary: You earned coins and a very loud story to tell.
